title: HP, Coherent, CH Robinson, Alibaba: 'Mad Money' Lightning Round
text:
Here's what Jim Cramer had to say about some of the stocks during the Mad Money Lightning Round :
HP ( HPQ ) : "This is a very strong stock. I say buy, buy, buy."
Coherent ( COHR ) : "This company is the best at what it does."
CH Robinson Worldwide ( CHRW ) : "That's one of the best stocks out there. "
Yirendai ( YRD ) : "I don't really follow this one. I like Alibaba ( BABA ) and Baidu.com ( BIDU ) in China and that's about all."
Simon Property Group ( SPG ) : "This is a well-run company, they'll survive this weakness."
Green Plains Renewable Energy ( GPRE ) : "I think this one is a bad idea."
